slice: P2 AC1027 MLINE angle-retarget projection with cap-suppression flags
scope: Permit the selected AC1027 angle-retarget projection for open MLINE consumers whose group-71 flags preserve the has-vertices bit and optionally set documented start/end-cap suppression bits. The target MLINESTYLE changes from 90/90 to 60/120 degrees; consumer geometry is projected while the original group-71 flags remain unchanged.

specEvidence.group41: Element parameters describe per-element segment intersections, starts and cuts. Cap suppression is carried separately in group 71.
specEvidence.interpretation: The projection preserves group-71 cap flags while recalculating endpoint miters and group-41 values. The separation of these documented fields supports this selected transport; native cap rendering is not independently verified.

contract.admission: For the angle-retarget path only, group 71 must contain the has-vertices bit, must not contain the closed bit, and may contain only the documented cap-suppression bits. Selected values are 5 (suppress start), 9 (suppress end), and 13 (suppress both). Closed value 3 and unknown-bit value 17 refuse. Any non-1 group-71 value remains refused by offset-only, append and removal projection paths until separately qualified.
contract.projection: Preserve the input MLINE entity flags and style identity fields. Recompute endpoint miter directions and group-41 first parameters for the target 60/120-degree style while retaining source positions, baseline directions, per-element tails and empty area-fill parameter lists.
contract.outputAndReadback: Runtime-authored AC1027 sources cover flags 5, 9 and 13 across ASCII/binary input and output (12 positive combinations). Physical output checks group 71, style references, endpoint group 13 and group-41 values for the ENTITIES and BLOCKS consumers; fresh typed readback checks the same flags, geometry and target style.
contract.failureAndRetry: Closed and unknown flag profiles each refuse while preserving a destination sentinel; the same writer succeeds with a corrected flags-13 source. A late consumer-parameter mutation on the flags-13 profile also refuses atomically and succeeds on the same adapter after restoring caller state.
contract.compatibility: The change is limited to AC1027 DXF angle-retarget projection. The prior flags-1 projection path is unchanged. Other versions, offset-only changes, appends, removals, closed MLINE projection and native rendering remain outside this qualification.

sourceBindings.fixtureRecipe: retargetRecipe in tests/dxf_fixture_tests.cpp writes all MLINE and MLINESTYLE source records at runtime to temporary files. No drawing fixture is committed.

focusedSelector.summary: 1/1 passed in 0.92s; added 12 positive cap-flag encoding profiles, 2 closed/unknown-bit refusals, 2 correction retries, and one late-mutation refusal with same-adapter retry. Existing angle, offset/angle composition, flags-only refusal and retry cases also pass.

validation.asan: NOT_RUN; this slice adds no allocation, ownership, lifetime, bounds or handle path.

limitations: Only AC1027 and the selected three-vertex, two-consumer angle-retarget profile are covered.
The documented flag and parameter fields are preserved and read back, but native cap appearance and rendered geometry are not qualified.
Offset-only projection, appends, removals, other flags, other versions, complete-document closure and support claims remain outside this receipt.
next: Qualify the currently refused AC1027 group-340 offset-only retarget for one selected cap-suppression flag profile; retain exact output/readback, closed/unknown refusal and same-adapter retry controls.
